acceptedBasins.why: Termignon (Val d'Isere, Pointe du Montet side, 3116-3343 m): the Termignon 1 and Termignon 2 drags plus their red run form a self-contained pod. You ski in at 3356 m and the drags return you only to 3330 m - 22 m below, and 114 m away from, the nearest node outside. The way on from here is the off-piste descent toward Termignon, which is freeride terrain, not a mapped piste. Reviewed on the map by the user: free-ride off-piste, do not add a link. We never invent terrain we cannot verify, so this is signed off rather than bridged.
